title: Fix incomplete course deletion cleanup (DB tables, preferences, and study UI state)
todo_items: Refs: ISSUE-034. Keep moving output files to DATA_DIR/deleted/. (1) Backend CourseRepository.delete_course(code): also delete KeyPointsRecord, TutorMessageRecord, and course-specific UiPreferenceRecord keys (place:<code>, examNotice:<code>, audio:<code>:%, and course == code). (2) Frontend: on deleteCourse(code), forget course preferences and reset #activeJobs; when currentCoursesList.length === 0 in initStudyPortal(), reset currentStudyCourse = null, activeStudyLectureNo = null, studyHistory = [], studyMistakes = [] and clear all study/overview/review DOM panels (top-bar picker, 課程目錄 right pane, breadcrumbs, PDF reader, audio player, side keypoints, workbench panels, 研讀總覽, 弱點複習). (3) Add regression tests in tests/test_course_settings.py.
